_comment: Generated by scripts/check-fork-preserved.py --record. `removed` is the ONLY way a symbol may leave the tree: add the name plus a reason, so the loss is a decision, not an accident of a merge.

removed_reasons.ChatScrollOwner: superseded by upstream's ChatScrollPolicy.FollowLatch (PR #341). Two owners of the viewport was the conflict; upstream's latch is the one that ships and is covered by 27 tests.
removed_reasons.ScrollOwnershipState: same removal: the @Observable owner container existed to fix a freeze caused by owner transitions. Upstream's latch produces far fewer transitions instead, so the container has nothing left to isolate.
removed_reasons.TranscriptMessageContent: dead after the 1.6.0 merge: its only remaining reference was its own definition, and upstream's follow latch now owns the viewport, so nothing instantiated it. It was kept compiling anyway — Swift type-checks unused declarations — and its 40-argument row was the second expression that stalled the type checker (ChatTranscriptView.swift:1216). Removed with the row builder extracted, so the file keeps one row path instead of two.
removed_reasons.ActivitySummaryRow: superseded by the new Usage screen: the busiest-weekday/hour figures are now UsageTotalsCell rows built in InsightsViewModel.swift:529 and drawn by UsageMetricCell (UsageTotalsGrid.swift:28). Same icon/label/value/detail content, as grid cells.
removed_reasons.AnalyticsCard: superseded by UsageMetricCell (UsageTotalsGrid.swift:28) driven by UsageTotalsCell (InsightsViewModel.swift:574): the same label-plus-value figure, now a two-up grid cell instead of a list row.
removed_reasons.AssistantTurnTimestampFormatter: renamed to ChatMessageTimestampFormatter (ChatMessageMeta.swift:143), which keeps the identical shortTime(forUnixTimestamp:) API and the locale/time-zone test seam.
removed_reasons.ChatPrependScrollPositionController: our own addition after the fork point, superseded by upstream's ChatScrollPositionController (ChatTranscriptSupportingViews.swift:451), whose .prepend mode compensates for content inserted above the reader. Same job, one controller instead of one per prepend path.
removed_reasons.ComposerMetaControlLabel: merged into ComposerInlineControlLabel (ChatComposerSelectorControls.swift:304): upstream's single quiet toolbar-row label replaces both of our meta and secondary-bar labels.
removed_reasons.ComposerModelMenu: superseded by ComposerModelEffortMenu (ChatComposerSelectorControls.swift:104), which folds the model picker and the reasoning effort into one UIKit menu.
removed_reasons.ComposerModelPickerSheet: superseded by the shared ModelPickerSheet (HermesMobile/Features/Shared/ModelPickerSheet.swift:10), now used by both the composer and Settings > Default Model.
removed_reasons.ComposerReasoningMenu: merged into ComposerModelEffortMenu's effortMenu (ChatComposerSelectorControls.swift:195) with ComposerModelEffortSelection (:254): effort is now a submenu of the model menu, not a sibling control.
removed_reasons.ComposerSecondaryBarLabel: merged into ComposerInlineControlLabel (ChatComposerSelectorControls.swift:304): upstream uses one control for the capsule second-bar label and the meta label (ComposerWorkspaceSelectorButton, ComposerProfileSelectorMenu).
removed_reasons.CronJobMetadataRow: superseded by TaskConfigurationField (TaskConfigurationFields.swift:4) rendered as a Grid in TaskDetailView.configurationCard (TaskDetailView.swift:168); the same Schedule/Next/Last label-value rows.
removed_reasons.DailyTokenRow: superseded by UsageChartCard (UsageChartCard.swift:10) fed by UsageBuckets.daily (UsageChartData.swift:138): the per-day figures moved from a list of rows into the window chart's day buckets.
removed_reasons.DiffLineRow: superseded by the ReviewDiff canvas: ReviewDiffLine (ReviewDiff/ReviewDiffRow.swift:53) built by ReviewDiffRowBuilder and painted by drawCodeRow (ReviewDiff/ReviewDiffCanvasView+Drawing.swift:221).
removed_reasons.FileBreadcrumb: no replacement: upstream rebuilt the file browser as an in-place expanding tree (FileBrowserView.swift:190 FileTreeRowView; FileTreeExpansionStore in FileBrowserViewModel.swift:269) with no breadcrumb bar. The path affordance is gone; recorded here because a human decision is needed, even though the type was upstream's own.
removed_reasons.FileBrowserRow: superseded by FileTreeRowView (FileBrowserView.swift:190): the same 42 pt icon/name/chevron row, now indented by tree depth and carrying a child count.
removed_reasons.GitToolbarStatusDot: superseded by GitToolbarPresentation (GitWorkspaceViewModel.swift:456) plus GitAheadBehindBadges (GitWorkspaceView.swift:165): the single .gray dirty dot is replaced by ahead/behind badges and the toolbar's accessibilityValue.
removed_reasons.GitTurnDiffSheet: superseded by GitDiffView (GitDiffView.swift:7) presented through ChatView.turnDiffSheet (ChatView.swift:1326, .sheet(item: turnDiffPresentation) at :1109); it already lists the turn's files and drills into each.
removed_reasons.LucideBrainIcon: superseded by the LucideBrain asset image (ReasoningBlockView.swift:40, Image("LucideBrain")): upstream ships the glyph as an asset instead of a Canvas-drawn path.
removed_reasons.ModelBreakdownRow: superseded by UsageModelRow (UsageModelRows.swift:23) inside UsageModelsCard: the same model name plus token/session/cost/cache line, now a two-column row.
removed_reasons.ModelPickerButton: superseded by the shared ModelPickerSheet (HermesMobile/Features/Shared/ModelPickerSheet.swift:10): the per-row select button is now the sheet's list row.
removed_reasons.ModelPickerCard: superseded by the shared ModelPickerSheet (HermesMobile/Features/Shared/ModelPickerSheet.swift:10): its titled sections are the sheet's sections.
removed_reasons.ModelPickerSearchField: superseded by ModelPickerSheet's search bar (HermesMobile/Features/Shared/ModelPickerSheet.swift:90, .searchable): the same filter field, local to the shared sheet.
removed_reasons.ProfilePickerCard: superseded by the shared picker rows in DefaultProfilePickerView (DefaultProfilePickerView.swift:41 profileRow, PickerRowMetrics in ModelPickerSheet.swift:746): the titled card is gone and rows sit directly on the list.
removed_reasons.ProfilePickerSearchField: superseded by the .searchable drawer on DefaultProfilePickerView (DefaultProfilePickerView.swift:62): the same search, now the system search bar.
removed_reasons.ProviderRow: superseded by ProviderDisclosure (ProvidersView.swift:156): the provider row is now a disclosure that expands its model list.
removed_reasons.ProvidersStatusRow: superseded by the inline Label rows in ProvidersView (ProvidersView.swift:88, :98): Loading, load-failure, and empty states are ContentUnavailableView labels now.
removed_reasons.SessionListNewChatReturn: renamed SessionListDestinationReturn (SessionListView.swift:1619): the same helper with the same run(from:to:suppressEmptyPlaceholders:refreshSessions:) signature, generalized to refresh on any destination change.
removed_reasons.ToolCallCardView: superseded by ToolCallLogRowView (ToolCallLogRowView.swift:6) built on the shared TranscriptLogRowView: the tool call is now a dense log row instead of a bordered card.
removed_reasons.ToolCallStatusDisplay: superseded by ToolCallLogRow.Status (ToolCallSummaryFormatter.swift:5) with statusText and ToolCallDetailBodyView.statusText (ToolCallLogRowView.swift:98): the same Completed/Failed/Running verdicts.
removed_reasons.TranscriptStatusPill: superseded by the status glyph slot in TranscriptLogRowView (TranscriptLogRowView.swift:156) drawn by ToolCallLogRowView.statusGlyph (:37): a symbol, not a capsule text pill.
